name: 丁秀儀

Teaching students to do the research work on Information and Financial Management and to write the papers. Before graduation, the students have possessed the ability to do the R / D work. 延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.

課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
remarks: 一、	類別  學生分組實作及討論 二、內容 (1) 第 17 週: 各組針對自選專題議題報告。 (2) 第 18 週: 針對 17 週議題報告，各組歸納出一份簡報，並在課程中用 10 分鐘報告。 三、時數 總共 4 小時。 四、學習成果 第 16 週課程結束前各組須繳交第 17 週之議題報告；第 18 週上課前需繳交歸納簡報。 五、評量比例 (1) 期中與期末專題報告: 50%  (2) 17-18 週課堂報告表現: 10% 遠距教學的規畫，請加入 Line，ID:0937143666，來討論
